value.answer: Right now the lowest 5-year fixed I can find is about 4.34% if you're under 20% down, from Ratehub and WOWA as of this week. With 20% or more down it's around 4.44%, and the big banks are more like 5.17% on average. Rates are climbing: the lowest insured rate is up about 0.3 points in the last month, so the number moves fast and differs by lender and down payment.
